title: Void Tear
description: A ragged tear in reality hangs in the air like a wound that refuses to close, leaking dark energy that distorts the ground beneath it. The edges pulse with a sickening un-light, and the faint sound of something vast breathing echoes from within. Fragments of shattered matter orbit the tear slowly, drawn toward oblivion.

choices.label: Reach into the void
choices.description: Plunge your hand past the boundary of reality to seize what lies within the tear.

outcomes.text: Your fingers close around something impossibly cold. You wrench it free — a crystallized shard of pure void, thrumming with dark potential.
The tear bites back. Something inside claws at your arm as you reach through. You pull free with entropy residue clinging to your skin like burning tar.
The tear widens as you disturb it. A wave of void energy blasts outward, and shapes move in the darkness beyond — something is coming through!

choices.label: Collect the leaking residue
choices.description: Scrape the condensed entropy dripping from the tear's edges into a container.

outcomes.text: The entropy drips in thick, slow drops that hiss against your container. A generous collection of potent material.
You collect a good amount, but the fumes make your head swim. The entropy seems to feed on your focus.
A sudden surge from the tear sprays entropy across your party. It clings and burns, dissolving fabric and searing exposed skin.

choices.label: Leave it alone
choices.description: Some wounds in reality are best left undisturbed.

outcomes.text: You give the tear a wide berth, feeling the pull of oblivion tugging at your clothes as you pass. It breathes in, disappointed, and you hurry on.
